name: Welcome Modal
description: Startup workspace picker overlay shown when no CLI path is provided. Displays a centered modal with app name, 'Select a workspace' subtitle, 'Open Workspace' button (native directory picker via IPC), 'Close' button (closes app), and recent workspaces list (clickable with remove button, missing paths detected and styled differently). Returns Promise<string | null>.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Show overlay, load recent workspaces, return path on selection or null on close
